statement: For every finite K>=1 and every original EXCH-001 trajectory from Q=Qbar and (E_P-H)/V>=delta>0, x(1-x)>=delta^2/(2 epsilon^2 (rho_star+1/4) q^2) at every canonical time, where x=Qpsi/Qbar and 1-x=2Qchi/Qbar. The positive floor is independent of K and time. At delta=1/10000 these sublevels are nonempty for every K and the floor is 20155392/70059765625.
scope: Conditional pinned R-158 P1, one periodic 3-torus of side 16, exact Fourier K/2K, full complex fields, original positive floors and canonical Hamiltonian bracket/time. Qbar=11008/27 and E_P=mu_t Qbar on that sector. Applies to all sublevel states, not just minimizers.
verification: Two independent derivations (moment envelope before absorption, pointwise absorption before integration); 17 executed rational/symbolic checks; six compiled Lean scalar lemmas; hostile review and three-page render review. No external referee.
missing_inputs: No spatial/time compactness or convergence; no native physical preparation, state or clock. No global spatial lower bound for either density.
falsifier: Wrong volume or factor-two charge weighting, invalid moment absorption, loss of exact nonempty sublevel at some K, or an in-scope state sequence tending to a pure charge share.
reentry: A specific mathematical error or a separately justified new scientific input. No optically matched sign test, next theorem or limit study is authorized by this result.
non_claims: No rate of exchange, equilibration, phase selection, Lyapunov control of individual orbits, continuum dynamics, Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity or mass gap. C6 T1 and T-054 unchanged.
